attack.title: Attack
attack.description: Attack with a weapon or Unarmed Strike. Unarmed Strike options: Damage (1 + STR mod Bludgeoning), Grapple (target makes STR/DEX save vs DC 8 + STR mod + PB), or Shove (same save; push 5 ft. or knock Prone).

dash.title: Dash
dash.description: For the rest of the turn, give yourself extra movement equal to your Speed.

disengage.title: Disengage
disengage.description: Your movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the turn.

dodge.title: Dodge
dodge.description: Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and you make DEX saves with Advantage. Lost if Incapacitated or Speed is 0.

help.title: Help
help.description: Help another creature's ability check or attack roll, or administer First Aid (DC 10 WIS (Medicine) to stabilize a creature with 0 HP).

hide.title: Hide
hide.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to become hidden.

influence.title: Influence
influence.description: Make a Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) or Wisdom (Animal Handling) check to alter a creature's attitude.

magic.title: Magic
magic.description: Cast a spell, use a magic item, or use a magical feature.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Prepare to take an action in response to a trigger you define (uses your Reaction).

search.title: Search
search.description: Make a Wisdom (Insight, Medicine, Perception, or Survival) check.

study.title: Study
study.description: Make an Intelligence (Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion) check.

blinded.title: Blinded
blinded.description: Can't see. Auto-fail sight checks. Attacks have disadvantage. Attacks against have advantage.

charmed.title: Charmed
charmed.description: Can't attack the charmer. The charmer has advantage on social checks against you.

exhaustion.title: Exhaustion
exhaustion.description: Cumulative levels 1-6. Each level imposes -2 to d20 rolls. Speed reduced. Death at level 6.

frightened.title: Frightened
frightened.description: Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while the source of fear is within line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to the source.

grappled.title: Grappled
grappled.description: Speed becomes 0. Can't benefit from any bonus to speed.

invisible.title: Invisible
invisible.description: Impossible to see without magic or special senses. Advantage on attacks. Attacks against have disadvantage.

paralyzed.title: Paralyzed
paralyzed.description: Incapacitated. Can't move or speak. Auto-fail STR/DEX saves. Attacks against have advantage. Melee hits are automatic critical hits.

petrified.title: Petrified
petrified.description: Turned to stone. Weight multiplied by 10. Incapacitated and unaware. Resistance to all damage.

poisoned.title: Poisoned
poisoned.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

prone.title: Prone
prone.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls. Melee attacks against have advantage. Ranged attacks against have disadvantage. Must use half movement to stand.

restrained.title: Restrained
restrained.description: Speed becomes 0. Attacks have disadvantage. Attacks against have advantage. Disadvantage on DEX saves.

stunned.title: Stunned
stunned.description: Incapacitated. Can't move. Can speak only falteringly. Auto-fail STR/DEX saves. Attacks against have advantage.

unconscious.title: Unconscious
unconscious.description: Incapacitated, prone, drop held items. Auto-fail STR/DEX saves. Attacks against have advantage. Melee hits are automatic critical hits.

bloodied.title: Bloodied
bloodied.description: A creature is Bloodied while it has half its Hit Points or fewer remaining.

half.title: Half Cover (+2 AC, +2 DEX saves)
half.description: An obstacle blocks at least half of the target's body. Examples: low wall, furniture, another creature.

threeQuarters.title: Three-Quarters Cover (+5 AC, +5 DEX saves)
threeQuarters.description: An obstacle blocks at least three-quarters of the target's body. Examples: arrow slit, thick tree trunk.

total.title: Total Cover
total.description: The target is completely concealed. Cannot be targeted directly by attacks or spells.

cold.title: Cold
cold.description: Freezing cold, ice, and arctic winds.

force.title: Force
force.description: Pure magical energy -- Magic Missile, Eldritch Blast.

piercing.title: Piercing
piercing.description: Stabbing and puncturing -- arrows, spears, bites.

slashing.title: Slashing
slashing.description: Cutting and cleaving -- swords, axes, claws.

thunder.title: Thunder
thunder.description: Concussive sound waves and sonic booms.

ammunition.title: Ammunition
ammunition.description: Requires ammunition to make a ranged attack. Each attack expends one piece of ammo. Drawing ammo is part of the attack.

finesse.title: Finesse
finesse.description: Use your choice of STR or DEX modifier for attack and damage rolls.

heavy.title: Heavy
heavy.description: Small creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls with this weapon.

light.title: Light
light.description: Can engage in two-weapon fighting when wielded alongside another light weapon.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: You can fire only one piece of ammunition per action, bonus action, or reaction, regardless of number of attacks.

range.title: Range
range.description: Listed as two numbers: normal range and long range. Attacks beyond normal range have disadvantage. Cannot attack beyond long range.

reach.title: Reach
reach.description: Adds 5 feet to your melee reach when you attack with it and for opportunity attacks.

thrown.title: Thrown
thrown.description: Can be thrown to make a ranged attack using the same ability modifier you would use for a melee attack.

twoHanded.title: Two-Handed
twoHanded.description: Requires two hands when you make an attack with it.

versatile.title: Versatile
versatile.description: Can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property and is the damage when used with two hands.

settingsPage.restoreDefaultSettingsDesc: — non-destructive. Resets theme, audio levels, accessibility options, keybindings, and turn-server config to their defaults. Your campaigns, characters, library, homebrew, macros, drafts, and notifications are NOT touched.
settingsPage.restoreDefaultsConfirm: Restore default settings? Theme, audio, accessibility, keybindings, and turn-server config will reset. Characters, campaigns, library, and macros will be untouched.

settingsPage.signalingNotApplicable: Only checked on a direct LAN connection. Off-LAN, games run through the cloud relay — no peer-to-peer signaling server is needed.

abilityScoresGrid.strengthDesc: Measures physical power. Affects melee attack and damage rolls, carrying capacity, and Athletics checks. Used for STR saving throws against being physically restrained or moved.
abilityScoresGrid.dexterityDesc: Measures agility and reflexes. Affects ranged attack rolls, AC, initiative, and Acrobatics/Sleight of Hand/Stealth checks. Used for DEX saving throws to dodge area effects.
abilityScoresGrid.constitutionDesc: Measures endurance and vitality. Affects hit points gained per level and CON saving throws to maintain concentration on spells or resist poison and disease.
abilityScoresGrid.intelligenceDesc: Measures reasoning and memory. Affects Arcana/History/Investigation/Nature/Religion checks. Primary spellcasting ability for Wizards. Used for INT saving throws against mental effects.
abilityScoresGrid.wisdomDesc: Measures perception and intuition. Affects Animal Handling/Insight/Medicine/Perception/Survival checks. Primary spellcasting ability for Clerics, Druids, and Rangers. Used for WIS saving throws against charm and fear.
abilityScoresGrid.charismaDesc: Measures force of personality. Affects Deception/Intimidation/Performance/Persuasion checks. Primary spellcasting ability for Bards, Paladins, Sorcerers, and Warlocks. Used for CHA saving throws against banishment.

backgroundPanel.darkvisionDesc: You can see in dim light within range as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.
backgroundPanel.blindsightDesc: You can perceive your surroundings without relying on sight, within a specific radius. Creatures without this sense are effectively blinded with regard to creatures with it.
backgroundPanel.tremorsenseDesc: You can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within a specific radius, provided you and the source are in contact with the same ground or substance.
backgroundPanel.truesightDesc: You can see in normal and magical darkness, see invisible creatures and objects, automatically detect visual illusions and succeed on saving throws against them, and perceive the original form of a shapechanger or a creature transformed by magic.

toolProficiencies.lightArmorDesc: Made from supple materials, light armor lets agile adventurers keep their full DEX modifier to AC. Examples: Padded (AC 11), Leather (AC 11), Studded Leather (AC 12).
toolProficiencies.mediumArmorDesc: Offers more protection but limits mobility. Add DEX modifier to AC (max +2). Examples: Hide (AC 12), Chain Shirt (AC 13), Breastplate (AC 14), Half Plate (AC 15).
toolProficiencies.heavyArmorDesc: The best protection at the cost of mobility. No DEX modifier added to AC. Some impose stealth disadvantage. Examples: Ring Mail (AC 14), Chain Mail (AC 16), Splint (AC 17), Plate (AC 18).
toolProficiencies.shieldsDesc: A shield is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your AC by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
